create.name: Andrew Harvey
create.bio:
Andrew Harvey is a writer, scholar and teacher of mysticism who was born in Coimbatore in south India in 1952. After reading history at Oxford he was elected a Fellow of All Souls College at just twenty-one, but in 1977 he went back to India, and a run of mystical experiences there turned him towards a spiritual life. Later years brought Bodhisattva vows in Ladakh under Thuksey Rinpoche, a long study of Rumi and Sufism in Paris, and a formative meeting with Father Bede Griffiths.

His teaching draws on many traditions at once: Rumi and Kabir, Christian mysticism, the Divine Mother, Tantra, Sri Aurobindo and Buddhism. Its thread is what he calls Sacred Activism, the conviction that real inner awakening should show itself as compassionate action in a troubled world, and he leads the Institute for Sacred Activism. He has written or edited more than thirty books, among them A Journey in Ladakh, The Hope and, in 2026, The Magdalene Revolution. Today he offers spiritual direction by phone, online courses (several of them with The Shift Network) and pilgrimages to sacred places in India, Turkey and beyond.

books.title: The Hope: A Guide to Sacred Activism
books.author: Andrew Harvey
books.description: His handbook on Sacred Activism, setting out how a spiritual practice can grow into practical service. He argues that a world in crisis needs inner work and outward action together.

courses.title: Spiritual Direction with Andrew
courses.description: Private fifty-minute phone sessions for seekers of any tradition or none. Andrew listens to your path and gives you a personal practice to keep; packages of three or six sessions are also offered.

courses.title: Sacred Turkey: The Way of Rumi
courses.description: A two-week pilgrimage through Turkey in the footsteps of Rumi, led by Andrew and organised by Sacred Earth Journeys. Booking is with the tour operator.

courses.title: The Ultimate Rebellion Against Darkness & Despair
courses.description: An online training with The Shift Network on joy as a source of courage in hard times. Its practices are meant to turn hopelessness into purposeful action.

courses.title: Rediscover the Christ Path
courses.description: An online course with The Shift Network exploring the mystical teaching of Jesus. It looks at how that teaching can be lived as compassion in daily life.

courses.title: Rumi and the Way of Passion
courses.description: Ten online sessions with The Shift Network on Rumi's life and poetry. Andrew reads the poems as a guide to devotion and compassionate action.
